proof_obligations.statement: The release and proof rows on sp_read_open_intelligence_execution_result_chain_v2 are correct only once the P3 caller slices move release_open_intelligence_run.py (L198, L517 to L518) and issue_r3_execution_proof.py (L136) from the v1 chain reader to sp_read_open_intelligence_execution_result_chain_v2. Step 6 must verify that by a readback of the caller code at the candidate commit before the first native run; until then a native run of release or proof would call the v1 reader and fail on permission.

Secret Manager attaches IAM to the secret, not the version. The version pin on SOCIALCRAWL_OGILVY_API_KEY is expressed as a resource.name condition on the secret. Step 6 readback must prove native acceptance of that condition and that the job references the version by number so resource.name is evaluable.

unresolved.statement: Cloud Scheduler has no job-level IAM. Creating or updating intelligence-42-daily-staging or intelligence-42-price-policy-staging through the deploy identity would need project-level roles/cloudscheduler.admin, which reaches the production schedulers. No scheduler binding is proposed and the deploy identity holds no actAs on the scheduler account; the operator who creates the two scheduler jobs is the principal that needs roles/iam.serviceAccountUser (actAs) on intelligence-42-scheduler, and that grant is made to the operator at provisioning time, as decision c of R03_DECISIONS_APPROVAL_20260913.json records.

No manifest identity is bound to ogilvy-trends-v2-execution-approvals-staging. The retained bootstrap proof shows bootstrap/manifests, bootstrap/signatures and bootstrap/locks written through the legacy bootstrap path. Assign a v2 writer only when the v2 approval flow names one.

The caller of sp_approve_open_intelligence_execution_v2 and sp_disable_open_intelligence_execution_approval_v2 is a human principal outside the manifest identities; review_auth is prepared, not enrolled. No binding is proposed.

No engine script is yet bound to intelligence-42-ingest-staging, and the existing connectors read secrets outside the manifest; the only manifest secret, SOCIALCRAWL_OGILVY_API_KEY, is bound to the funded pilot per successor-wave1-pilot.json. The decision is what 42 staging ingestion collects; the manifest must move first, adding the secret version rows, before this file can carry those bindings.

The runtime loader reads its build through cloudbuild.googleapis.com (_default_build_reader), which needs cloudbuild.builds.get, and Cloud Build offers that only at project scope as roles/cloudbuild.builds.viewer. Native precedent: eight legacy execution identities hold roles/cloudbuild.builds.viewer at project level in r03-project-iam-readback-0805.json. The recommendation is that Albert extend the project-level exception class to that role for the seven execution identities. No binding rows are added and the validator exception class is not widened until that decision is recorded. Since amendment d the daily job runs collection_exposure_issue, r3_apply, r3_proof_issue and r3_release under intelligence-42-orchestration, so that account joins the members and the four retired accounts leave them.

roles/run.developer on listening-post-staging carries run.services.update and run.services.setIamPolicy and run.services.delete alongside get; the plan asks for describe and update only. A custom role limited to run.services.get, run.services.update, run.revisions.get, run.revisions.list and run.operations.get would fit, but the reviewed manifest has no custom role row for it and this file binds only manifest rows, so run.developer stays with its breadth stated in the document. A custom role needs a manifest row first.
